incomeDefinition: Includes interest, fees and other income from the lender’s finance operations. Repayments of the original loan are excluded.
definition: Profit after the costs and expected credit losses recognised in the accounts, and after tax.
location: Exchange financial results, audited 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026 column, income and expense lines and rows 15 and 18.
notes: Interest income was ₹6,140.81 crore compared with ₹2,766.67 crore of finance cost. The group recognised ₹1,104.13 crore of impairment on financial instruments, largely money it estimates may not be recovered under the relevant contracts. The table does not divide group profit among individual loan products.
insight: Interest is the main source of operating revenue. Funding costs and expected losses both matter when assessing how much the group earned for shareholders.
